headline: Mastermind of syndicate extorting crores by staging human trafficking drama arrested
summary: A syndicate leader has been apprehended for allegedly orchestrating fake human trafficking schemes to extort millions of taka. The arrest follows an investigation into their fraudulent activities.
details: The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested the alleged mastermind of a syndicate involved in a sophisticated fraud scheme. This individual is accused of orchestrating a 'human trafficking drama' to extort significant sums of money from victims.

The syndicate reportedly defrauded people of crores of taka by fabricating scenarios of human trafficking. This elaborate deception was used to illicitly gain wealth, preying on vulnerable individuals.

Authorities are continuing their investigation into the full scope of the syndicate's operations and to identify other members involved. Further details regarding the victims and the exact methods used in the fraudulent scheme are expected to emerge.
